disqualifiers.text: Late bids will not be considered.
Bids received after the bid deadline will be filed unopened.
The City of Tucker reserves the right to reject any and all bids or any part, to waive any formalities to make an award and to re-advertise in the best interest of the City.

disqualifiers.text: 1. The selected firm shall be GDOT prequalified in work class 8.01 The selected firm or subcontractor shall be GDOT prequalified or registered in work classes 6.04(a) and 6.04(b).
All Proposals will initially be classified as either “responsive” or “non‐responsive”.

Proposals may be found non‐responsive any time during the evaluation process or contract negotiation if any of the required information is not provided; the submitted price is found to be excessive or inadequate as measured by criteria stated in the RFP; or the Proposals is not within the plans and specifications described and required in the RFP. If a Proposal is found to be non‐responsive, it will not be considered further.
Such a determination may be made at any time during the evaluation process and through contract negotiation if information surfaces that would result in a determination of non‐responsibility.
If an offeror is found non‐responsible, the determination must be in writing, made a part of the procurement file, and mailed to the affected offeror.
